Parthenon LLC Has $4.44 Million Position in Apple Inc. (AAPL) Posted by Dante Gardener | Feb 3rd, 2018 
Parthenon LLC grew its holdings in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 5.0% in the 3rd quarter, according to its most recent disclosure with the Securities & Exchange Commission. The institutional investor owned 28,816 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after acquiring an additional 1,379 shares during the period. Parthenon LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $4,441,000 as of its most recent SEC filing. 
A number of other hedge funds have also bought and sold shares of AAPL. TD Capital Management LLC raised its stake in Apple by 5.2% during the 2nd quarter. TD Capital Management LLC now owns 4,150 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $598,000 after purchasing an additional 206 shares during the last quarter. Johanson Financial Advisors Inc. raised its stake in Apple by 3.5% during the 2nd quarter. Johanson Financial Advisors Inc. now owns 53,649 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $7,719,000 after purchasing an additional 1,822 shares during the last quarter. Lincoln Capital LLC raised its stake in Apple by 4.1% during the 2nd quarter. Lincoln Capital LLC now owns 2,537 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $365,000 after purchasing an additional 100 shares during the last quarter. Pure Financial Advisors Inc. increased its holdings in Apple by 2.1% in the 2nd quarter. Pure Financial Advisors Inc. now owns 17,294 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $2,491,000 after buying an additional 348 shares during the period. Finally, Carlson Capital Management increased its holdings in Apple by 61.5% in the 2nd quarter. Carlson Capital Management now owns 10,100 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $1,455,000 after buying an additional 3,847 shares during the period. 60.26% of the stock is owned by institutional investors. In other Apple news, insider Daniel J. Riccio sold 15,641 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction that occurred on Tuesday, November 14th. The shares were sold at an average price of $172.35, for a total transaction of $2,695,726.35. Following the sale, the insider now directly owns 39,682 shares in the company, valued at approximately $6,839,192.70. The sale was disclosed in a filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is accessible through this link . Also, insider Eduardo H. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Insiders have sold a total of 128,412 shares of company stock worth $22,115,155 over the last 90 days. Corporate insiders own 0.08% of the company’s stock. 
Shares of Apple Inc. ( NASDAQ AAPL ) opened at $160.50 on Friday. The firm has a market cap of $788,300.00, a P/E ratio of 16.51, a P/E/G ratio of 1.36 and a beta of 1.33. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.73, a current ratio of 1.28 and a quick ratio of 1.23. Apple Inc. has a 52-week low of $128.16 and a 52-week high of $180.10. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share for the quarter, beating analysts’ consensus estimates of $3.82 by $0.07. The business had revenue of $88.29 billion for the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $87.62 billion. Apple had a net margin of 21.13% and a return on equity of 37.84%. Apple’s revenue for the quarter was up 12.7% on a year-over-year basis. During the same period last year, the company posted $3.36 EPS. research analysts predict that Apple Inc. will post 11.14 earnings per share for the current fiscal year. 
The business also recently announced a quarterly dividend, which will be paid on Thursday, February 15th. Shareholders of record on Monday, February 12th will be issued a dividend of $0.63 per share. The ex-dividend date of this dividend is Friday, February 9th. This represents a $2.52 annualized dividend and a yield of 1.57%. Apple’s dividend payout ratio (DPR) is currently 25.93%. 
AAPL has been the topic of several analyst reports. Vetr lowered shares of Apple from a “strong-buy” rating to a “buy” rating and set a $173.47 price target on the stock. in a report on Friday, October 6th. UBS Group reissued a “buy” rating and issued a $180.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Monday, October 9th. Drexel Hamilton reissued a “buy” rating and issued a $208.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Monday, October 9th. Royal Bank of Canada reissued an “outperform” rating and issued a $180.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Tuesday, October 10th. Finally, Morgan Stanley reaffirmed a “buy” rating and issued a $199.00 target price on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, October 11th. Two research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, thirteen have given a hold rating, thirty-six have issued a buy rating and two have given a strong buy rating to the company’s stock. Apple Company Profile 
Apple Inc (Apple) designs, manufactures and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players, and a variety of related software, services, peripherals, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. The Company’s products and services include iPhone, iPad, Mac, iPod, Apple TV, a portfolio of consumer and professional software applications, the iOS and OS X operating systems, iCloud, and a variety of accessory, service and support offerings.
